title: Facing split-screen player HUD: horizontal
summary: Player HUDs follow each facing viewport, with pause and camera controls contained in player 1's view.
details: PR #683 merged as d48c7ca4ff6e45581f78777e5d7a68ef1b44c2e6 (implementation head 23b55ad). Web, native and Android CI checks passed.

Parent ran test_engine_split_facing.mjs against successful PR artifact run 43665193152: 1 passed, 0 failed in 27 seconds; fh and fv both had player tag counts [1,1], player 1 toolbar containment, camera and pause taps, and simultaneous steering/driving touches.
Screenshot independently inspected before publication; horizontal facing layout shown. Production deployment verification belongs to the implementation parent.
limitation: Authored split-screen/touch adaptation; this does not establish original PS2 behavior or physical-device usability. Automated input and screenshots used host Chromium at 844x390, not physical phones.
